targets.name: RNC_DecodePayloadToVRAM
targets.result: Decodes the compressed payload and streams reconstructed words to VDP_DATA while preserving the source block's row/column progression.

targets.name: RNC_ReadBits
targets.result: Reads a variable-width field from the RNC bit buffer and refills the source word when the current buffer is exhausted.

targets.name: RNC_BuildDecodeTable
targets.result: Builds the RNC Huffman decode table from compressed code lengths and entries.

targets.name: TerrainResource_ReadDecodedSize
targets.result: Reads the four-byte decoded-size header used by TerrainBehaviorTable_Decode to calculate its output end.

targets.name: TerrainResource_ReadBits
targets.result: Reads a variable-width field from the terrain-resource bit buffer and refills its compressed source word as needed.

targets.name: TerrainResource_BuildDecodeTable
targets.result: Builds the terrain-resource Huffman decode table before TerrainBehaviorTable_Decode expands the runtime behavior resource.

targets.name: VDP_FillWords
targets.result: Writes a constant word to a sequential VRAM destination for the requested count.

conclusion: The named functions form two parallel compressed-resource decoders and the constant VDP transfer primitive. They explain resource construction paths without adding any new direct scene-state or player-transfer writer.
